source_en: Build a restrained comic contrast between a plainly visible small practical mishap and a participant's conspicuously composed posture or expression; let the partner's directed reaction connect the contrast to their encounter.
source_application_contract: Optional general photographic composition guidance. This is not a prescribed whole-scene template or native visual profile. Apply only as an independently justified authorial decision on open dimensions, with actual final evidence. It supplies no actor, relationship, age, object, hard obligation or source qualification. Preserve any independently required owner, contact, actuator and support endpoints; partial or unobservable required evidence cannot pass. Research metadata and search exposure never confer native adoption authority.
criteria: A small visible practical mishap or awkward imbalance coexists with one participant maintaining a conspicuously composed expression/posture.
The partner directs an amused response toward that contrast; two undifferentiated pleasant smiles do not by themselves establish the selected contrast.
limits: Qualitative visible realization of retained generic guidance, not native whole-source approval, optical metrology or a causal image ablation.
